decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P 500 +0.2%), with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. ENSG and CLS show strong multi-signal setups but lessons learned say not to force new buys into idle cash on a neutral day — better to wait for a genuine risk-on confirmation. Holding all 7 existing positions unchanged; stop-loss and profit-target rules remain active automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with the NASDAQ up just 0.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.2%, suggesting investors were in a wait-and-see mode rather than aggressively buying or selling. Without a strong directional catalyst, broad momentum stayed muted across most sectors. This kind of quiet, low-conviction session often precedes either a breakout or a pullback once new information arrives.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平淡，納斯達克僅升0.1%，標普500升0.2%，反映投資者普遍採取觀望態度，未見明顯買賣方向。在缺乏強力催化因素下，大部分板塊的動力維持溫和。此類波動收窄的交易日，往往是市場在等待新消息出現後，才會選擇突破或回調的前奏。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Patience in investing means not feeling pressured to put cash to work just because it's sitting idle. On a neutral day with no strong market signal, holding off on new buys — even with good-looking candidates — can protect you from chasing moves that fizzle out, saving your capital for a clearer opportunity.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 投資中的「耐性」是指不因現金閒置而感到必須立即投入市場。在大市方向不明的平淡日子，即使有看似不錯的候選股，暫緩新買入也能避免追逐隨後可能落空的升勢，將資金留待更明確的機會出現時再部署。
